subject: dplyr and Sql server and RODBC

messages.author: 71335e4c86a7e748
messages.subject: dplyr and Sql server and RODBC
parts:
Has anyone taken a stab at implementing a dplyr interface to mssql or RODBC?
Looking at Hadley's recent vignettes,http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/vignettes/new-sql-backend.html , it seems that with an existing DBI interface it "shouldn't" be too difficult.
For mssql we have rsqlserver, a very recent package.
For RODBC we could maybe use RJDBC (which is dbi) and then a JDBC ODBC bridge.
Of course, we could also implement a dbi interface to RODBC, but I somehow doubt that it would be easier.

Any thoughts or any ongoing attempts? I would be happy to collaborate.
